description: Defines data models and related methods for managing threads and thread memberships in Mattermost, including structures for thread metadata, responses, options, and membership validation.

classes.name: Thread
classes.description: Represents metadata for a root post and its replies within a thread.

classes.name: ThreadResponse
classes.description: Represents detailed information about a thread, including participants and post details.

classes.name: Threads
classes.description: Container for multiple ThreadResponse objects and total counts.

classes.name: GetUserThreadsOpts
classes.description: Options for fetching user-specific thread lists with filtering and pagination.

classes.name: ThreadMembership
classes.description: Models the relationship between a user and a thread, including follow status and view timestamps.

classes.name: ThreadMembershipForExport
classes.description: Data structure for exporting thread membership details.

methods.name: Etag
methods.description: Generates an ETag string based on PostId and LastReplyAt for cache validation.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the ThreadMembership's PostId and UserId.
